caption: The drawing depicts an ornate frame with classical architectural features rendered primarily in a golden yellow color, with decorative accents and detailing throughout. The frame has columns on either side with leaf-like patterns and a pediment at the top, which is semi-circular and intricately decorated. The base of the frame appears to rest on a simulated marble plinth with gray and light pink veining. Inside the frame, there is a depiction of a bearded figure with light brown hair and a halo, dressed in a blue robe with a white undergarment. The figure is positioned with one arm raised and the other holding a rod or staff, standing on a patch of brown ground with a blue sky and some clouds in the background. The overall composition centers the framed figure, with architectural elements symmetrically flanking the central image. There is a small inscription in the lower right-hand portion of the drawing.
title: Original Tabernacle, for Communion Vessels
